reason: v12's directive regex treats an unclosed `%%{` as a directive and removes it, with the line break after it (or, with a `{` argument, the rest of the text); v13's preprocess keeps the text and reports UNCLOSED_DIRECTIVE, so the treeView is rejected rather than silently cut (core preprocess behaviour, as for pie, radar, treemap and wardley; the lexer gate excludes the same cases, #571).
